reports.title: Workiva Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: As of November 5, 2026, Workiva is providing guidance as follows:
•Total revenue is expected to be in the range of $275 million to $278 million.
•GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 7.1% to 7.7%.
•Non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 19.0% to 19.5%.
•GAAP net income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $0.40 to $0.42 using 60.3 million shares.
•Non-GAAP net income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $0.78 to $0.80 using 60.3 million shares.
•Total revenue is expected to be in the range of $1.041 billion to $1.044 billion.
•GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 6.2% to 6.3%.
•Non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 18.2% to 18.3%.
•GAAP net income per diluted share is expected to be in the range of $1.31 to $1.34 using 56.0 million shares.
